text:
Alex (AE): Quick heads-up — AcmeCorp POC needs PO + e-sign. Procurement insists on a physical 'signature stamp' and a 'funds release' milestone. Need to confirm net terms (they asked for Net45) and whether we can accept a scanned PO before countersign. @Maria can you advise on stamp + funds release language? @Sam can you route invoice flow? thx

Maria (Legal): I reviewed the redlined MSA they sent. I pushed comments — remove the unilateral escrow/KMS export clause. 'Funds release' phrasing is vague and risky. Suggest we require: payment milestones subject to countersignature or written acceptance. I can draft replacement language for the order form.

Sam (SalesOps): Procurement says DocuSign only. Billing contact they gave: billing@acmecorp.com. I can pre-config envelope but need final OF. Finance prefers Net30 by default; Net45 will need Sales VP approval. Routing: finance mgr -> rev ops -> invoicing.

Jin (SE): For the POC we can provision an isolated token-based instance, no KMS exports. If Legal needs KMS integration wording we can provide a short paragraph for the OF. Also: Acme asked for 'demo SLA' — we can put a limited SLA for POC/demo hours only.

Alex (AE): They attached a scanned, signed PO that says 'signature stamp required' handwritten. Can we accept a PDF with their stamp + signature? They also want milestone 2 'funds release' after tests. @Maria can we add acceptance criteria to make milestone deterministic?

Maria (Legal): Accept scanned stamp if it's on an executed order form with a signature block. Do not accept open-ended 'funds release' language. Add acceptance criteria to the OF and tie payment to 'Customer's written acceptance' or an executed acceptance form. I'll add redline text: 'Payment for Milestone 2 is triggered upon Customer's written acceptance per Section X.'

Sam (SalesOps): I'll prepare a DocuSign envelope with two signers: Customer Admin -> Customer Finance. CC billing@acmecorp.com and cc legal@redwood.com. Envelope routing: signer 1 -> signer 2 -> CC. Anyone object if I pre-fill PO#? makes matching easier.

Jin (SE): For the POC SLA, propose short language: 'During POC period, response time < 500ms at 90th percentile and 99% availability during scheduled demo windows.' Keep it scoped to POC period only. Also proposing an acceptance checklist to attach: 
```
POC Acceptance Checklist:
- run test-suite (link)
- latency meets target
- customer signs acceptance email referencing test-run
```

Maria (Legal): Checklist looks good. Replace 'customer signs acceptance email' with 'Customer acceptance communicated via email to billing@redwood.com or via executed acceptance form attached to this Order Form.' That gives finance something to rely on.

Alex (AE): Great. @Sam I'll drop the final OF and the redlined MSA in this thread by 2pm PST. After that can you kick DocuSign?

Sam (SalesOps): Roger. Will schedule envelope for 3pm PST. If Net45 needs VP approval, @Terry (Sales VP) please confirm — we need a quick thumbs up. :pray:

Terry (Sales VP): approve Net45 for AcmeCorp POC given strategic fit. :+1:

deploy-bot: DocuSign envelope created by Sam — envelope_id: abc123 (https://docusign.example/envelope/abc123)

Alex (AE): Envelope sent. Customer started signing; finance on deck next. Keeping thread here for any hold-ups.

Sam (SalesOps): Received signed admin and finance signatures plus the scanned PO with stamp. Invoicing will issue invoice on Milestone 1 once we have countersignature and executed OF. Closing loop unless anyone sees a compliance/legal hold.

Maria (Legal): No further blockers from Legal — will archive redline thread and finalize language in OF. Thanks team.
